faqs.question: How do I choose between 4T4R and 8TR base-station RF components?
faqs.answer: Start with the radio architecture, number of transmit and receive paths, band plan, port mapping and mechanical envelope rather than choosing by channel count alone. Share these inputs with insertion loss, isolation, power and PIM targets. SONNE can then evaluate a suitable 4T4R or 8TR configuration against the project requirements.
faqs.intent: 比较基站架构并确定 RFQ 输入
faqs.snippet: 段落式 Featured Snippet，约 50–60 词，首句直接给选型依据。

faqs.question: How can low PIM be maintained across production batches?
faqs.answer: Batch consistency requires an approved sample baseline, controlled materials and assembly, defined test conditions, and traceable production records. SONNE has PIM, VNA, reliability and automated multi-port testing capabilities. The exact PIM limit, sampling or verification coverage, and report format should be agreed for each base-station product rather than assumed across the range.
faqs.intent: 验证低 PIM 批量一致性与测试覆盖
faqs.snippet: 段落式 Featured Snippet，约 55–65 词，强调项目级约定。

faqs.question: What information is needed to address co-siting interference?
faqs.answer: Provide the interfering and victim bands, transmit and receive frequencies, power levels, antenna or feeder arrangement, isolation targets and known site constraints. SONNE can review whether a base-station filter, duplexer or co-siting RF configuration is appropriate. Feeder-sharing and generic multi-band combining requirements are routed to the dedicated combiners line for evaluation.
faqs.intent: 排查共站干扰并选择正确产品入口
faqs.snippet: 清单转段落的 Featured Snippet，约 55–65 词，先列输入再给评估路径。

faqs.question: Can SONNE evaluate N28 and N78 base-station projects?
faqs.answer: Yes, N28 and N78 project requirements can be submitted for engineering evaluation, with published evidence covering lower-band designs and a 3400–3600 MHz 8TR example. Final feasibility depends on the complete Tx/Rx band plan, performance targets, power, PIM, interfaces and mechanical limits, so no single catalog specification should be assumed for every design.
faqs.intent: 确认 N28/N78 项目评估能力
faqs.snippet: 段落式 Featured Snippet，约 55–65 词，同时交代公开证据与限制。

faqs.question: Can I request a review before my base-station specification is complete?
faqs.answer: Yes. Submit the known band plan, architecture, target quantities and open questions, and clearly mark missing values. A complete RFQ normally receives initial engineering feedback in about 24 hours; this is not a quotation or lead-time guarantee. Prototype and production schedules are assessed separately from design complexity, quantity, process and capacity.
faqs.intent: 降低资料不完整时的询盘门槛
faqs.snippet: 段落式 Featured Snippet，约 55–65 词，明确响应边界。

faqs.question: Can I request an enclosure quote with only a 3D model?
faqs.answer: A 3D model is enough to begin an engineering review, but a reliable quotation normally also needs material, quantity, critical dimensions and tolerances, surface finish, assembly requirements and the drawing revision. Send STEP plus a 2D PDF when available. Missing items can be listed as open assumptions instead of being silently guessed.
faqs.intent: 判断现有图纸是否足以报价
faqs.snippet: 段落式 Featured Snippet，约 50–60 词，区分启动审查与可靠报价。

faqs.question: How can EMI shielding and thermal management be balanced?
faqs.answer: Review seams, apertures, connector openings, conductive interfaces, heat sources, airflow and service access together. The right balance depends on shielding targets, heat dissipation, allowable temperature rise and the installation environment. SONNE can assess these inputs with the mechanical design; any required EMC or thermal compliance must be confirmed and evidenced for the specific project.
faqs.intent: 解决 EMI 与散热协同设计问题
faqs.snippet: 段落式 Featured Snippet，约 55–65 词，以共同审查因素开头。

faqs.question: Which enclosure finishes and IP ratings are available?
faqs.answer: SONNE's published capabilities include powder coating and galvanizing, with IP55, IP65 and IP68 capability referenced for relevant enclosure projects. The available finish and achievable rating depend on the design, material, sealing method and use conditions. Request the applicable test evidence rather than assuming every cabinet or housing carries every rating.
faqs.intent: 确认表面处理、防护等级与证据
faqs.snippet: 段落式 Featured Snippet，约 50–60 词，明确能力不是所有产品统一认证。

faqs.question: Can SONNE support custom OEM enclosure dimensions and assembly requirements?
faqs.answer: Yes, the enclosure line is positioned for custom OEM/ODM projects. Submit overall dimensions, equipment layout, mounting interfaces, cable entries, access requirements, finish, quantity and applicable environmental targets. Feasibility, branding details, packaging and production terms are reviewed per project; no cross-line commercial policy should be assumed before confirmation.
faqs.intent: 确认 OEM 尺寸与装配定制范围
faqs.snippet: 段落式 Featured Snippet，约 50–60 词，先回答可做再列输入。

faqs.question: How long do enclosure prototypes and production take?
faqs.answer: A prototype in as fast as about two weeks is only a reference for suitable projects, not a general promise. Actual sample and volume schedules depend on drawing maturity, materials, quantity, processes, surface treatment and current capacity. A complete RFQ normally receives initial engineering feedback in about 24 hours, followed by a project-specific schedule assessment.
faqs.intent: 了解打样与量产时间边界
faqs.snippet: 段落式 Featured Snippet，约 55–65 词，避免固定交期承诺。

faqs.answer: Yes. Submit one BOM covering POI requirements, low PIM splitters, directional couplers and hybrid couplers, with model or function, frequency, power, PIM, connectors and quantities. Indoor antennas, loads and cable assemblies can be added through the RF accessories page. Each item is checked against its applicable datasheet rather than treated as one uniform specification.

faqs.question: Does every DAS component meet PIM of -160 dBc or better?
faqs.answer: No. The published value of up to ≤-160 dBc applies only to specific models, not automatically to the entire IBS/DAS range. Check the selected model's datasheet, test conditions and required power level. For project approval, request the applicable PIM evidence and agree on verification coverage before ordering.

faqs.snippet: 段落式 Featured Snippet，约 45–55 词，首句明确否定全系列推断。

faqs.question: What is the MOQ for IBS and DAS passive components?
faqs.answer: The source specification for this IBS/DAS line states MOQ 50+, and that limitation must not be applied to SONNE's other product lines. Confirm the exact model, quantity and order conditions with your BOM. Availability and production timing are reviewed per model and order rather than presented as a universal stock or delivery policy.
faqs.intent: 确认本辅助线 MOQ 与订单边界
faqs.snippet: 段落式 Featured Snippet，约 50–60 词，突出仅限本线。

faqs.question: Where is a 3 dB hybrid coupler used in an in-building DAS?
faqs.answer: A 3 dB hybrid coupler can split or combine signals while providing a defined phase relationship between ports, depending on the circuit and system design. In an in-building DAS, selection should consider frequency range, power, PIM, isolation, amplitude and phase balance, and connectors. Confirm these values on the specific model datasheet.
faqs.intent: 理解 3 dB 电桥在室内 DAS 的功能与选型
faqs.snippet: 定义型 Featured Snippet，约 45–55 词，先给功能定义再给核对项。

faqs.question: Should I use this page or the RF combiners page for my requirement?
faqs.answer: Use this page for in-building DAS BOMs centered on low PIM splitters, directional or hybrid couplers and POI requirements. Use the RF combiners page for generic duplexers, diplexers, multiplexers, multi-band combiners or RF power dividers. If the system includes both, submit the band plan and BOM so each requirement can be routed correctly.

faqs.snippet: 比较型 Featured Snippet，约 50–60 词，可用两句对照。

faqs.question: What IP rating can SONNE FTTX products achieve?
faqs.answer: IP68 is a published capability for splice-closure products, not a blanket rating for every FTTX box or cabinet. Other ratings must be confirmed against the exact enclosure design, cable entries and use conditions. Identify the product type and target rating in your RFQ, then request the applicable test evidence for that configuration.
faqs.intent: 确认不同 FTTX 产品的 IP 能力边界
faqs.snippet: 段落式 Featured Snippet，约 50–60 词，首句限定 IP68 类别。

faqs.question: Can FTTX enclosures be customized with OEM branding?
faqs.answer: Yes, custom enclosures and OEM branding are supported for FTTX projects. Submit dimensions, installation interfaces, internal layout needs, cable entries, quantities and logo artwork. Branding method, color, placement and production requirements are confirmed per project, along with any drawing or sample approval needed before volume production.
faqs.intent: 确认 FTTX OEM 结构与品牌定制
faqs.snippet: 段落式 Featured Snippet，约 45–55 词，直接回答并列出输入。

faqs.question: How are outdoor corrosion and finish requirements handled?
faqs.answer: Specify the installation environment, material preference, coating or color requirement, exposure conditions and expected maintenance constraints. SONNE has outdoor material and coating capabilities, but no universal corrosion duration, salt-spray rating or environmental compliance should be assumed. The applicable finish and any required evidence are confirmed for the exact project.
faqs.intent: 了解户外防腐和表面处理评估方式
faqs.snippet: 段落式 Featured Snippet，约 50–60 词，明确不预设盐雾或年限。

faqs.question: Can I request a custom FTTX box size or mounting arrangement?
faqs.answer: Yes, custom enclosure requirements can be reviewed. Provide the available space, mounting method, cable-entry locations, internal distribution or splicing needs, target protection level and estimated quantity. Feasibility and production timing depend on the final structure, materials, process and capacity, so they are assessed after the requirement package is complete.
faqs.intent: 确认尺寸与安装方式定制
faqs.snippet: 段落式 Featured Snippet，约 50–60 词，先回答再列项目输入。

faqs.question: What should I include when requesting IP test evidence?
faqs.answer: Identify the exact product category, model or drawing, target IP rating, cable-entry configuration and intended outdoor installation. Ask for evidence applicable to that configuration rather than a generic certificate. If the design is customized, confirm whether existing evidence remains applicable or whether additional project-specific verification is required.
faqs.intent: 获取与具体结构对应的 IP 测试资料
faqs.snippet: 清单式 Featured Snippet 候选，正文约 45–55 词，可前端拆成四项列表。

faqs.question: Can RF accessories be shipped together with the main components?
faqs.answer: Include the accessories and main components in the same project BOM and identify which items should ship together. SONNE supports same-factory project matching, but consolidated shipment must be confirmed for the specific order, models, quantities and production schedule. Do not assume a common delivery date before order review.
faqs.intent: 确认配件与主器件合并出货安排
faqs.snippet: 段落式 Featured Snippet，约 45–55 词，说明申请方式且不作统一承诺。

faqs.question: Are RF accessories in stock, and what is the MOQ?
faqs.answer: Stock and MOQ depend on the exact accessory model and order. SONNE does not publish one cross-product-line stock or MOQ policy for this accessories page. Send the model, quantity and required date for an order-specific review. Pricing and production or delivery timing are confirmed separately from the initial engineering response.
faqs.intent: 确认配件库存、MOQ 与价格条件
faqs.snippet: 段落式 Featured Snippet，约 45–55 词，明确需按型号订单确认。

faqs.question: Can I replace a termination load using only the connector and power rating?
faqs.answer: No. Connector type and power rating alone are not enough to confirm a replacement. Also check the original model, frequency range, impedance, VSWR, connector gender, mechanical limits and PIM requirement where applicable. Provide the datasheet or clear nameplate photographs so the proposed load can be reviewed against the original specification.
faqs.intent: 降低负载替换选型错误
faqs.snippet: 段落式 Featured Snippet，约 50–60 词，首句直接否定不充分条件。

faqs.question: What is needed for a custom RF cable assembly inquiry?
faqs.answer: Provide the cable type or performance target, frequency range, length, connector series and gender at both ends, orientation, quantity and installation constraints. Include electrical or environmental requirements when applicable. SONNE can review the assembly against these inputs; feasibility, pricing and delivery are confirmed for the exact configuration rather than inferred from a similar photograph.
faqs.intent: 准备定制 RF 电缆组件询价
faqs.snippet: 清单式 Featured Snippet 候选，答案约 50–60 词，可前端拆成字段列表。

faqs.question: Do all indoor DAS antennas cover 698–3800 MHz?
faqs.answer: No frequency range should be applied to every indoor antenna without checking its model datasheet. Use the required 698–3800 MHz range as an RFQ filter, then confirm gain, VSWR, polarization, power, connector and mounting requirements for the selected antenna. The appropriate model depends on the complete DAS design and installation conditions.
faqs.intent: 核实室内 DAS 天线频段与型号适配
faqs.snippet: 段落式 Featured Snippet，约 50–60 词，强调型号级核对。
